settings.label: Amazon storefront is live
settings.info: Leave OFF until the Amazon Influencer storefront page actually exists. While OFF, storefront buttons point at the on-site picks grid instead of a 404 — individual product links still earn commission. Turn ON the day amazon.com/shop/<handle> works.

settings.label: Amazon Storefront URL
settings.info: Your Amazon Influencer storefront URL — e.g. https://amazon.com/shop/julianmonge. Only used when the checkbox above is ON.

settings.label: Amazon Associate tag
settings.info: Your Amazon Associates tag (e.g. julianmonge02-20). Any Amazon URL rendered on the site that doesn't already include ?tag= or &tag= will get this one appended automatically.

settings.label: WhatsApp number
settings.info: Country code + number, digits only. Used by the floating WhatsApp button. Leave blank to hide.
